end.summary:
Practised distinguishing a point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
Aryan gave 2 unaided correct responses out of 5 attempts.
They identified that a segment has two fixed endpoints and a line extends in both directions.
Aryan’s belief that a ray has two endpoints remained at the end of the lesson.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised using endpoints and arrows to tell a point, line segment, line and ray apart. They correctly described a segment as having two fixed endpoints and a line as extending in both directions. There was a mix-up about rays: Aryan noticed the single arrow and partly identified one endpoint, but still said a ray has two endpoints at the end. At home, use quick sketches and ask Aryan to mark each figure’s endpoints and arrows before naming it.
